    Offscreen Wiki

    OffscreenCleanroom lets mods open Minecraft screens in separate desktop windows. It provides a Java API for Minecraft 1.12.2 on Cleanroom, with optional ModularUI and Had Enough Items (HEI) support.

    Your first windowInstall the library and open a screen from your addon. Connect ModularUI and HEIChoose a local or server-backed screen, enable the ingredient overlay and handle readiness. Save window values and connect controls to the serverKeep each window’s values separate and connect controls to server storage. Animations and custom renderingCompose motion, transform elements and choose a caption font. Images, video and audioDecode media in the background and draw it in an animated layer. ExamplesBuild nine complete tools with source in Java, Kotlin, Scala, Groovy and ZenScript. TroubleshootingFind help with installation, input, scaling, and window behavior. API recipesCreate screens, handle input and connect server-backed controls.
    API Shortcuts
    • Window API reference

    • Custom screen callbacks
    • Buttons

    Call the window API on Minecraft's main client thread. Offscreen draws each window on that thread and restores the game's rendering state afterwards.

    ModularUI and HEI adapters load when those mods are installed. Offscreen requires Cleanroom's SDL/LWJGLY backend; it cannot run on ordinary Forge's LWJGL2 backend.
